external_collaboration.evidence_quote: NIH has successful bilateral learning and teaching mobility with partners in Canada and USA. NIH also has important partner institutions in Europe through Joint and double degrees (2nd cycle) and Nordplus Idrott, a Nordic network.

external_collaboration.partner_name: Erasmus Mundus Master in Transcultural European Outdoor Studies (TEOS)
external_collaboration.evidence_quote: NIH has been a participating partner in three joint/double master degree programs. Erasmus Mundus Master in Transcultural European Outdoor Studies (TEOS), Erasmus Mundus Master in Adapted Physical Activity (EMMAPA), and European Master in Health and Physical Activity (EMHPA).
